title:
[Bug]: offsetText is colored based on tick.color instead of tick.labelcolor
### Bug summary

In vers

observations: Bug title: offsetText is colored based on tick.color instead of tick.labelcolor
Setting ytick.labelcolor or xtick.labelcolor in styles/rcParams does not change exponent label (offsetText) color
Exponent label incorrectly uses xtick.color / ytick.color
Reproduction code: uses plt.rcParams.update({'ytick.labelcolor': 'red'}) and plots large numbers (1.01e9, etc.) to trigger exponent offset label
Images referenced: wrong_color.png and correct_color.png (not visible but described)
User provided a patch to axis.py lines 2203 and 2456, suggesting the fix is to use labelcolor unless it's 'inherit' (then fall back to tick.color)
Patch targets XAxis and YAxis offset_text initialization
Bug affects both x and y axes
No OS, backend, Python version, Jupyter version, or installation details provided
